meta.title: Same Mulank, alag saal — 2026 → 2027
meta.cta: send to someone who needs it + link to the complete 2027 guide
meta.text_rules: min 48 px, max 2 text items on screen, captions count

beats.line: Same Mulank… phir uska sab sahi kaise, mera nahi?!

caption_chunks.text: phir uska sab sahi kaise, mera nahi?!

beats.picture: Rooftop night. Monty's phone shows a friend's story (face not shown): new car, '2026 ✓'. Frame 0: Monty's jaw half dropped, thin smoke from his head; then his arm drops. Hook text 'SAME MULANK, ALAG KISMAT?' from frame 0, 'Tumhare saath bhi hua?' at 1.5 s.
beats.camera: Starts on the phone, pulls back to Monty.

beats.picture: MEME (original Steven He audio), Monty lip-syncs: clutches chest, knees wobble, crack runs across his phone. Vishnu ji NOT on screen.

beats.line: Arre, mulank same hai… saal nahi.
beats.picture: First time we see Vishnu ji on his cloud: popcorn flies into his mouth, eyebrow up.

beats.line: Maan lo, do log. Dono ka mulank 3.
beats.picture: Sakshi walks in (two side-steps), cards float by her hand. Two big cards pop with silhouette faces: 'WOH · 12 APRIL' and 'TUM · 3 MARCH', both stamped 'MULANK 3'. Small tag 'Example'.
beats.camera: Two-shot Sakshi + Monty, cards on top.
beats.sound: Anime wow on entry, card pops.

beats.line: Personal year: date + month + saal… single digit tak jodo.
beats.picture: On screen: 'DATE + MONTH + SAAL', then '2026 = 2+0+2+6 = 10 → 1' and '15 → 1+5 = 6'.
Cards build: '12 APR → 1+2+4+1 = 8' (gold 8 pops on WOH), '3 MAR → 3+3+1 = 7' (quiet 7 on TUM).

beats.line: Numerology mein 8 matlab result ka saal. 7 matlab ruk ke, andar kaam karne ka saal.

caption_chunks.text: Numerology mein 8 matlab result ka saal.
7 matlab ruk ke, andar kaam karne ka saal.

beats.picture: Label 'In numerology'. Trophy on 8; lamp and book on 7. Monty slumps, tiny rain cloud over only him.
beats.sound: Our sad trombone at the slump.

beats.line: Aur bhai ruko… climax abhi baaki hai!
beats.picture: MEME (original CarryMinati audio), Monty lip-syncs: palm up on 'ruko', grin on 'climax'. Behind him the wall calendar's 2026 page tears off by itself, 2027 underneath, fireworks.
beats.camera: Wide rooftop, calendar on the wall.

beats.picture: MEME (original Puneet Superstar audio), Monty lip-syncs with an evil grin, chin toward the WOH card (no finger pointing).

beats.line: Arre, 9 bura nahi. Purana samet ke, saaf karne ka saal.

caption_chunks.text: Purana samet ke, saaf karne ka saal.

beats.picture: On the WOH card old boxes pack themselves and a broom sweeps (calm).

beats.line: Aur 8 matlab mehnat ka result… lottery nahi.
beats.picture: Bricks stack beside Monty; a lottery ticket floats away. Label 'In numerology'.

beats.line: Mulank batata hai tum kaun ho… personal year, mausam kaisa hai.

caption_chunks.text: Mulank batata hai tum kaun ho…

beats.picture: Vishnu ji serene, chakra spins slowly behind him; sun and rain icons swap over a small Monty. Label 'In numerology'.

beats.line: Jiska mulank same par haal alag, usse bhejo. Poori 2027 guide ke liye, link pe click karo.

caption_chunks.text: Jiska mulank same par haal alag, usse bhejo.
Poori 2027 guide ke liye, link pe click karo.

beats.picture: Sakshi winks; big send arrow, then link chip. No deity. On screen 'SEND IT TO SOMEONE WHO NEEDS IT' then 'COMPLETE GUIDE → LINK'.
Monty taps send and grins; Vishnu ji munches popcorn. Card: 'Send to someone who needs it · Complete guide: link'. Loops to frame 0.
